task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Build the graph state for the graph [(0, 1), (0, 2), (0, 3), (1, 2), (1, 4), (2, 4), (3, 4)] in Qiskit (H on all, CZ per edge) and verify every stabilizer K_v = X_v prod_{u in N(v)} Z_u has expectation +1 using StatevectorEstimator. Your answer must be the complete working code only, runnable from top to bottom.
